#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
MF-2: Y-Stratified Non-Differential Misclassification Test (vectorized)
Uses np.bincount for O(n) confusion matrix computation.
"""
import argparse, json, re, sys
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np

K = 3
LABEL_TO_IDX = {"pro": 0, "con": 1, "neutral": 2}
POS = {"good","great","best","love","right","support","agree","positive","benefit","important"}
NEG = {"bad","worst","hate","wrong","against","oppose","negative","harm","dangerous","fail"}

def load_config(path):
    texts, topics, gs, ps = [], [], [], []
    with open(path) as f:
        for line in f:
            r = json.loads(line)
            gl = r.get("gold_label","").lower().strip()
            pl = r.get("pred_label","").lower().strip()
            if gl not in LABEL_TO_IDX or pl not in LABEL_TO_IDX: continue
            texts.append(r["text"])
            topics.append(r.get("topic","unknown"))
            gs.append(LABEL_TO_IDX[gl])
            ps.append(LABEL_TO_IDX[pl])
    return texts, topics, np.array(gs, dtype=np.int32), np.array(ps, dtype=np.int32)

def cm_from_idx(lin_idx, mask=None):
    if mask is not None:
        li = lin_idx[mask]
    else:
        li = lin_idx
    counts = np.bincount(li, minlength=K*K).reshape(K,K).astype(np.float64)
    cs = counts.sum(axis=0)
    C = np.full((K,K), np.nan)
    for k in range(K):
        if cs[k] > 0:
            C[:,k] = counts[:,k] / cs[k]
    return C

def max_dev(C0, C1):
    d = np.abs(C0 - C1)
    v = ~np.isnan(d)
    return float(np.nanmax(d)) if v.any() else 0.0

def frob_dev(C0, C1):
    d = C0 - C1
    v = ~np.isnan(d)
    return float(np.sqrt(np.nansum(d[v]**2))) if v.any() else 0.0

def sentiment(text):
    w = set(re.findall(r'\w+', text.lower()))
    p, n = len(w & POS), len(w & NEG)
    return 1 if p / (p + n + 1) > 0.5 else 0

def perm_binary(lin_idx, y, nperm, rng):
    m0, m1 = y==0, y==1
    C0, C1 = cm_from_idx(lin_idx, m0), cm_from_idx(lin_idx, m1)
    T_obs = max_dev(C0, C1)
    frob = frob_dev(C0, C1)
    Tp = np.empty(nperm)
    for b in range(nperm):
        py = rng.permutation(y)
        Tp[b] = max_dev(cm_from_idx(lin_idx, py==0), cm_from_idx(lin_idx, py==1))
    p = (1 + np.sum(Tp >= T_obs)) / (1 + nperm)
    return {"n_y0":int(m0.sum()),"n_y1":int(m1.sum()),
            "max_deviation":round(T_obs,6),"frobenius_deviation":round(frob,6),
            "p_value":round(float(p),6),"null_95pct":round(float(np.percentile(Tp,95)),6),
            "reject_005":bool(p<=0.05)}

def perm_categorical(lin_idx, y_arr, groups, nperm, rng):
    gc = Counter(y_arr)
    Cg = {g: cm_from_idx(lin_idx, y_arr==g) for g in groups}
    mpw = 0.0
    for i,g1 in enumerate(groups):
        for g2 in groups[i+1:]:
            d = max_dev(Cg[g1], Cg[g2])
            if d > mpw: mpw = d
    Cs = np.array([Cg[g] for g in groups])
    with np.errstate(all="ignore"):
        ve = np.nanvar(Cs, axis=0)
    T_obs = float(np.nanmax(ve)) if not np.all(np.isnan(ve)) else 0.0
    Tp = np.empty(nperm)
    for b in range(nperm):
        py = rng.permutation(y_arr)
        pCs = np.array([cm_from_idx(lin_idx, py==g) for g in groups])
        with np.errstate(all="ignore"):
            pv = np.nanvar(pCs, axis=0)
        Tp[b] = float(np.nanmax(pv)) if not np.all(np.isnan(pv)) else 0.0
    p = (1 + np.sum(Tp >= T_obs)) / (1 + nperm)
    return {"n_groups":len(groups),"groups":{str(g):int(gc[g]) for g in groups},
            "max_pairwise_deviation":round(mpw,6),"p_value":round(float(p),6),
            "null_95pct":round(float(np.percentile(Tp,95)),6),"reject_005":bool(p<=0.05)}

def process(texts, topics, gold, pred, nperm, rng):
    lin_idx = pred * K + gold
    acc = float(np.mean(gold==pred))
    lens = np.array([len(t) for t in texts])
    y1 = (lens > np.median(lens)).astype(np.int32)
    print("    text_length...",end="",flush=True)
    r1 = perm_binary(lin_idx, y1, nperm, rng)
    print(f" p={r1['p_value']:.4f}")
    tc = Counter(topics)
    big = {t for t,c in tc.items() if c >= 20}
    tm = np.array([t if t in big else "other" for t in topics])
    groups = sorted(set(tm))
    print("    topic...",end="",flush=True)
    r2 = perm_categorical(lin_idx, tm, groups, nperm, rng)
    print(f" p={r2['p_value']:.4f} ({r2['n_groups']}g)")
    y3 = np.array([sentiment(t) for t in texts], dtype=np.int32)
    print("    sentiment...",end="",flush=True)
    r3 = perm_binary(lin_idx, y3, nperm, rng)
    print(f" p={r3['p_value']:.4f}")
    return {"n_samples":len(gold),"n_valid":len(gold),"overall_accuracy":round(acc,4),
            "text_length":r1,"topic":r2,"sentiment":r3}

def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--permutations",type=int,default=10000)
    ap.add_argument("--data-dir",type=str,required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--output-path",type=str,default="/tmp/nondiff_y_stratified_results.json")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    dd = Path(args.data_dir)
    fs = sorted(dd.glob("*.jsonl"))
    print(f"Configs: {len(fs)}, Perms: {args.permutations}",flush=True)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
    pc = {}; r5=r1_=0; ap_=[]; am=[]
    for fp in fs:
        nm = fp.stem
        tx,tp,g,p = load_config(fp)
        print(f"\n  {nm}: {len(g)} samples",flush=True)
        res = process(tx,tp,g,p,args.permutations,rng)
        pc[nm] = res
        for pn in ["text_length","sentiment"]:
            pv,md = res[pn]["p_value"],res[pn]["max_deviation"]
            ap_.append(pv); am.append(md)
            if pv<=0.05: r5+=1
            if pv<=0.10: r1_+=1
        pv,md = res["topic"]["p_value"],res["topic"]["max_pairwise_deviation"]
        ap_.append(pv); am.append(md)
        if pv<=0.05: r5+=1
        if pv<=0.10: r1_+=1
    tt = len(pc)*3
    conc = (f"Non-differential misclassification supported: 0/{tt} tests reject at alpha=0.05"
            if r5==0 else f"Differential detected: {r5}/{tt} tests reject at alpha=0.05")
    out = {"description":"Y-stratified non-differential misclassification test for VAST (K=3)",
           "n_configs":len(pc),"n_proxies":3,"total_tests":tt,"permutations":args.permutations,
           "summary":{"rejections_at_005":r5,"rejections_at_010":r1_,
                      "max_deviation_across_all":round(max(am),6),
                      "median_p_value":round(float(np.median(ap_)),6),
                      "min_p_value":round(min(ap_),6),"conclusion":conc},
           "per_config":pc}
    with open(args.output_path,"w") as f:
        json.dump(out, f, indent=2)
    print(f"\n{'='*60}",flush=True)
    print(f"Saved: {args.output_path}",flush=True)
    print(f"Tests={tt} Rej@0.05={r5} Rej@0.10={r1_}",flush=True)
    print(f"Min p={min(ap_):.4f} Med p={float(np.median(ap_)):.4f} Max dev={max(am):.4f}",flush=True)
    print(f"{conc}",flush=True)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
